title: Freya and the Confession
author: Gideon Amberdale
blurb: August Lockridge, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
